requirements.title: Fortran can reference C procedures and C-prototype-compatible procedures
requirements.definition: Fortran provides means to reference procedures defined by C and procedures describable by C prototypes.

pending.reference-c-defined-procedure: Mixed build plan: a C companion defines int add_one(int); Fortran declares an interoperable BIND(C) interface, initializes an integer(C_INT) sentinel to -77, calls add_one(41_C_INT), and expects 42_C_INT.
pending.reference-c-prototype-described-procedur: Fortran-only control plan: a BIND(C) Fortran procedure with a C-prototype-compatible interface is referenced through an explicit interface and returns a sentinel-derived exact integer result.

requirements.title: ISO_C_BINDING constants and Fortran facilities correspond to C types
requirements.definition: ISO_C_BINDING provides named constants for C-compatible representations, and Fortran facilities define derived types and interoperable enumerations corresponding to C types.

pending.interoperable-enumerations-correspond-to: Mixed build plan: use an interoperable enumeration with distinct enumerators 7 and 11, pass to a C function taking the corresponding enum or integer-compatible type, and verify the exact selected enumerator.

requirements.title: ISO_Fortran_binding.h enables C interoperation with descriptor-requiring Fortran dummies

pending.descriptor-dummy-interoperation: Mixed build plan: a C bridge receives a descriptor for an assumed-shape Fortran dummy initialized with [4,5,6], reads extents and elements through the header API, and returns exact checksum 15.
